propositions: test_contended_index_lock_cleared_during_backoff_succeeds fails flakily on macOS py3.13 CI when the runner is slow enough that git commit holds index.lock past the test's wall-clock timer expiration
test's threading.Timer deletes git's real index.lock held mid-commit instead of the planted test lock, causing git commit to fail with 'unable to write new index file'
under force_reclaim=True the planted young lock is reclaimed on first retry, allowing git commit to proceed and create its own lock before the timer fires
replacing wall-clock timer-based lock release with deterministic gitutil._retry_probe eliminates the timing window where the test can delete a lock owned by code under test
test must still prove that a contended young index.lock released mid-retry allows the write to succeed without modifying production code
